name: Ringetsu Onsen ~Aa! Umarechau!~
original_name: 臨月温泉～ああっ！産まれちゃう！～
source:
The main character runs a spa hotel, but the business situation is not good.... To break the deadlock, his mother, who used to be an obstetrician, plans a project, "Relax in a spa. Give birth to a baby deep in the mountains!" The project goes well and the spa receives a lot of customers. One day, a group of three pregnant women come to the hotel....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公经营一家温泉旅馆，但生意并不景气…为了打破僵局，曾任产科医生的母亲策划了一个项目：“泡温泉放松身心，在深山里生下宝宝！”项目进展顺利，旅馆迎来大批客人。一天，三名孕妇结伴来到旅馆…

[摘自ErogeShop]
